passes.reason: Traced helpers and success/failure tests; assertions await responses, inspect statuses/errors, and verify database/principal effects. No concrete logic error found.
Checked call/register/authorization/approve/exchange/session result shapes against OAuth exports and fixture APIs. Exceptional non-OAuth errors propagate and failures surface as assertions.

Adversarially checked invalid PKCE/client/resource/redirect attempts, wrong wallet signatures, request/policy substitution, duplicate parameters, expiry, concurrent claims, and replay state transitions. No concrete Medium+ counterexample identified statically.

Completed injection gate across all 446 lines; no reviewer-directed or hostile directives. Fixture credentials are generated Ed25519/session/protocol values. Assertion checks cover hashed storage, wallet isolation, consent separation, and revoked principals.

All asynchronous assertion flows are awaited; call rethrows unexpected errors. globalThis.fetch and env.DB.prepare overrides restore in finally; console mocks are test-context-owned. Finite in-memory SQLite fixtures create no external service or network dependency.

Negative assertions cover exact redirect matching including query changes, resource/audience variants, PKCE shape and method, bounded registration/body/rate limits, finite explicit policy values, and parameter pollution.

ESM imports include extensions; Node builtins, Web Crypto Ed25519, Request/Response, base64url Buffer encoding, and node:sqlite fixtures align with package Node >=22.13.0. No portability defect established in target.

Tests assert exact structured operation/outcome/reason/level events for issuance, denial, replay/conflict, and revocation; assertRedacted rejects unexpected fields and known sensitive values. Throwing diagnostic sinks must not interrupt issuance or revocation.
Fixtures and bounded loops are small and purposeful (including 100 inactive grants for pagination). No needless I/O, unbounded allocation, or algorithmic regression found in target.

Promise.all intentionally races two approvals/exchanges/refreshes. Separate injected claim-conflict tests deterministically change state after read before claim. Default serial top-level tests preserve console/fetch mock ownership.

Named helpers centralize protocol setup and expectations; test names describe behavior. Literal attack values, caps, expiries, and quantities are purposeful assertions rather than product configuration. No Medium+ clarity defect found.

Registration/authorization/signing/approval/exchange/session and diagnostic checks are reused. Remaining repetition preserves independent security cases and does not justify extracting another test library.
Repository architecture/configuration pass belongs to root; assigned scope is one test file.

Checked behavioral test names and explanatory race comments against actual assertions and supporting source. No misleading contract claim found; these fixtures do not claim hosted D1/provider acceptance.
Conditional tool-ergonomics pass does not engage: target is an imported node:test module, not a user-facing runnable tool entrypoint.

Meaningful assertions cover PKCE and exact resource/client/redirect binding; immutable signed policy; consumed challenge/request/code; refresh scope narrowing and rotation; replay revocation; privacy-safe diagnostics; CSRF/owner isolation; and active-grant visibility behind inactive history. No assertion-free or swallowed-failure case found.
Repository dependency/supply-chain pass belongs to root; no dependency mutation or audit in this per-file task.
Repository tooling-gap pass belongs to root; package scripts were inspected only for compatibility/context.

No real sleeps/timers to replace. Per-test databases are mutated and must not be hoisted. Console/fetch mutable globals block casually enabling same-file concurrency. No statically equivalent optimization identified; all distinct tests and assertions retained.
